kinprove-genealogy-research-recipes-gene.description: Genealogy/DNA research: unknown parentage and WATO; endogamy, family comparisons, Y/mt/X DNA, phasing, admixture, cross-vendor controls, match outreach; documentary identity, conditional hypotheses, GPS and standards audits; archival image/transcript/index coverage, Ukrainian Jewish-list triage, ELIB guides; Jewish-name/OCR searches; Russian-Empire names, registration and emigrant origins; Holocaust testimony; Russian/Soviet military, repression and 1944 deportation records. Workflows for Ancestry, MyHeritage, FamilySearch, JewishGen, HebrewBooks, Beider indexes, 23andMe, FTDNA, GEDmatch, DNA…
